ideas.pitch: A localized competitive programming testing suite with automated testcase generators and stress-testing utilities.
ideas.problem_statement: Walchand Collegiate Programming Contest (WCPC) competitive programming rounds with 8 problems of varied difficulty.
ideas.title: ICPCHelper Offline Virtual Judge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the ICPC-inspired competitive programming nature of the contest, helping participants debug and stress-test solutions rapidly under strict time limits.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative single-PC coding environment optimized for multi-user competitive programming sessions.
ideas.problem_statement: Final Round requiring team members to work together on one single PC.
ideas.title: TeamSync CP Multi-Editor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific bottleneck of multiple team members sharing a single keyboard and screen during the intense final round.

ideas.pitch: An instant algorithm visualizer designed to trace dynamic programming and graph theory problems from contest sets.
ideas.problem_statement: WCPC preliminary and final round problems focusing on logic, coding, and advanced problem-solving.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer WCPC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working, interactive demo that makes complex algorithmic execution transparent and easy to explain during judging.

ideas.pitch: A real-time submission tracker and penalty calculator for collegiate programming contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Walchand Collegiate Programming Contest multi-round structure with diverse problem difficulties.
ideas.title: CP Contest Analytics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate analytical utility for teams tracking leaderboard standings and standings strategies.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent snippet manager and template repository optimized for rapid retrieval during competitive contests.
ideas.problem_statement: WCPC competitive programming rounds pushing problem-solving skills to the limit.
ideas.title: Smart Problem Notebook for ICPC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on practical efficiency, giving competitive programmers a tangible tool to reduce boilerplate writing time.
